name: Dockarchy
author: XNinety9
description: Docker container status for local and remote (ssh) hosts in the Omarchy bar, with CPU/memory per container, start/stop/restart, logs and shell access.

barWidget.description: Monitor Docker containers across every docker context, local socket or remote ssh:// hosts alike.

schema.label: Docker contexts
schema.description: Which docker contexts to monitor. Leave empty to monitor every context. Add a remote server with: docker context create myserver --docker host=ssh://user@myserver

schema.label: Per-host timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long to wait for one host (matters for remote ssh:// contexts) before marking it unreachable.

schema.label: Show CPU / memory per container
schema.description: Runs docker stats on each poll (adds about a second).

schema.label: Group by Compose project
schema.description: Fold containers under their docker compose project, with start/stop/restart/logs for the whole project.

schema.label: Sort containers by
schema.description: State = running first, then by name. CPU and Memory put the hungriest first. Press t in the panel to cycle.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when a container turns unhealthy or stops on its own, or a host stops answering. Recoveries are the way back.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Text shown next to the whale, Python-style: {running} {total} {stopped} {unhealthy} {unreachable} {errors} {hosts}. e.g. "{running}/{total}" or "{running} up, {errors} err". Empty = icon only.

schema.label: Panel max height (px)
schema.description: The panel grows with its content up to this height, then scrolls.

schema.label: Alternate row shading
schema.description: Tint every other container row so neighbours are easy to tell apart.
